## Workload

Kofi Asante completed grading activity during 456 hours of rostered work. The workload comprised 836 reads, giving an average throughput of 1.8 reads per hour. This represents the recorded volume for the review period and provides a basis for assessing the time available for consistent grading and case consideration.

The workload was reviewed in relation to the number of cases processed and the hours recorded. The reported rate indicates that the expected activity was maintained across the period.

## Quality

A sample of 59 cases was checked again to assess grading consistency. The recorded agreement rate was 66.1 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support a consistent approach in subsequent grading.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, with Kofi Asante’s workload and quality results considered together.
